# v3-goal-b32-2026-10-19

Scope: PROMPT-b32 Section 1 (P1s) + 1.4 cron, plus H-4 / L-4 support and P3 (#452). Section 2–5 items not listed below are **not** in this PR.

## Section 1 — P1s
### 1.1 G-10 (GOAL-LOCK #45) — persistence / read-your-writes
- **Write journal** (`src/lib/write-journal.ts`): every server-acknowledged write (deleted id, created id, cash after) is kept per user in sessionStorage for 45 s and applied to every snapshot/cash read, including after a reload. A lagging read (TT: deleted rows back 6–8 s later, gone at ~17 s) can no longer bring a row or the old cash back; entries drop once the server agrees. Reconcile window 20 s → 45 s.
- **Ack-only success:** a save counts only when the server returns the saved row id (`acknowledgedId`). The slow path closes the dialog at 0.9 s with a "Saving…" loading toast (not success); success/rollback + error toast when the server answers. A 200 without the row id is a failure, rolled back, with an error (the lost NZ$1,000 deposit case).
- **Buy 2.97–4.30 s:** the dry-run cap check (an extra round trip on every new buy) now runs only within one holding of the smallest plan cap; the real POST still enforces the cap.
- Optimistic sell shows realised at once (average cost from the book on screen; FIFO figure replaces it). Cash rows no longer show "No price was stored on this line". Cash-below-zero check already gated on cash loaded (asserted).
- Reasoning: TT's evidence matches Totalum read lag after commit, not lost writes server-side; the client was trusting the lagging read. Confidence: medium-high for reappearing rows/cash; medium for the lost deposit (root cause unproven — now fails loudly instead of silently). Impact: no row resurrection on reload; no silent loss.

### 1.2 REG-1 signed in
- Session store lookup hard timeout 4 s → **1.5 s**. Fallback order: isolate cache → stale cache → **signed last-good session cookie** (`af_ls`, httpOnly, HMAC with the auth secret, bound to a hash of this session token, 30 min). Set by /api/session after a store-confirmed read. When the store is down the user-record read is skipped (no second 1.5 s wait), and a hung record read no longer turns the session into "unavailable".
- Load test (unit, hung store, cold isolate): 20 concurrent renders resolve the user from `af_ls` in < 3 s total; without the cookie, "unavailable" in < 2 s (was 4 s+, retried for minutes).
- Confidence: medium. Impact: no 25 s skeleton / 2-min "could not reach the sign-in service" for a browser that signed in within 30 min.

### 1.3 CR-2 (GOAL-LOCK #1) signed in
- Refusals and fixed facts (plans, paper book, FIF, **broker**) answer before the quota read or any network/model call; counting moves to the background. Whole request has a **9 s** hard deadline with a plain-facts reply.
- Broker intent: plain example list, "no particular order; not a ranking or an endorsement"; no speed/accuracy claims.
- FIF line corrected to "total cost of your FIF interests is more than NZ$50,000 at any time in the income year" (+ regression test).
- Note: the model system prompt still says "Never name any broker"; the static broker line names examples per Chief's instruction — flag for Lukas.

### 1.4 BS-01 (#66) / G-20 (#55)
- `.github/workflows/cron.yml` added (broker-sync daily 16:00 UTC, track-record every 6 h, `workflow_dispatch`, curl --fail with retries, no email, secret only from `secrets.CRON_SECRET`). Actions secret CRON_SECRET set via sealed box.
